newsitem.title: ITALY: Europe car sales seen up 8.5 pct in June - ANFIA.
newsitem.headline: Europe car sales seen up 8.5 pct in June - ANFIA.

text.p: The strong 50.7 percent jump in Italian new car registrations in June gave a boost to the European auto market, posting an 8.5 percent rise in new car sales to around 1.12 million, provisional data from Italian carmakers' association Anfia showed.
Anfia said in a statement that excluding Italy the rise was only 1.4 percent year on year.
In the first six months of the year, European registrations totalled 6.921 million. a rise of 1.5 percent year on year, but a fall of 3.7 percent without Italy.
In June, French car sales fell 30.2 percent to 93,200, the lowest monthly figure for 30 years, Anfia said.
But Spain continued to grow with a 20 percent rise, while Britain saw an increase in sales of 6.9 percent and Germany posted a 5.9 percent rise.
